title: Needs work
body: It’s a easy to use app, but there are a few issues which are demotivating: 1) miss one day on a habit and the plant dies - sometimes the day doesn’t allow for that particular habit to be done (like going away for Wash the Dishes), are we supposed to lie? 2) the noise will register that a task is done but the task doesn’t tick off and the calendar has set the dates on the wrong day of the week (27 Apr is Sunday not Monday). 3) I’ve set reminders to be one, but they don’t work.
author: Dottie Ghee

title: It is impossible to test the app
body: I can’t test the app. Every time I try to use the app it shows the screen to subscribe. So annoying!!
author: enriquecm

title: really good
body: love the app, however the "times per day" option for habits is a little confusing as you can't check off a habit multiple times during the day? (i wish we could) so i'm not really sure what it is supposed to be used for.
